battlenet_panel.ensure_normal: Keep Battle.net normal (log in at startup and keep running)
battlenet_panel.guard_desc: From app start, keep Battle.net running and logged in: ensure the region first (CN / Asia, restart with --setregion when needed), then log in automatically (CN NetEase web / Asia form typed in), and restart by the timeout rules above.
battlenet_panel.credentials_desc: CN and Asia accounts are saved separately in the user data folder (password encrypted). Switching logs out via the avatar menu and logs in with the new account; another region restarts Battle.net with the region argument.
battlenet_panel.abnormal_restart: Restart on abnormal timeout (connecting / disconnected / login failed / stuck loading)
battlenet_panel.login_restart: Restart on login timeout (login screen / browser confirm / logging in)
battlenet_panel.region_prompt: Ask to restart Battle.net when the region changes
battlenet_panel.region_restart_ask: Region switched to {0}. Quit and restart Battle.net now with the official region argument?

decompile.tools_desc: Downloaded into the program data folder: ILSpy (.NET to C#, needs the .NET SDK), de4dot-cex (.NET deobfuscation), autoit-ripper (compiled AutoIt to .au3, needs Python), UPX (unpack). Already installed tools are kept.
decompile.rosbot_desc: Main program (deobfuscate, then decompile) plus every plugin DLL; writes settings_fields.md with all setting names (RoS-BoT.ini keys). Method bodies protected by DNGuard HVM are decrypted only at runtime and stay as stubs.
decompile.rbassist_desc: Compiled AutoIt program: extracts the .au3 script and embedded files (UPX is unpacked first when needed).
decompile.file_desc: Detects the type automatically: .NET assembly, compiled AutoIt, or native code (not supported).
decompile.recover_sources: Export available sources and attempt DNGuard recovery
decompile.chain_desc: Checks that all tools run, then decompiles configured ROSBOT, plugins and RBAssist into a new folder. Saves chain_report.json. DNGuard placeholder bodies are reported as partial recovery. Select a restored assembly under Any file to inspect an external recovery result.
decompile.passed: Chain passed: tools ran and all targets produced output without detected DNGuard placeholders.
decompile.incomplete: Chain incomplete: check the log and chain_report.json for missing tools, failed targets or protected method bodies.

yolo_training.python_exe: Python interpreter (empty = find one with Ultralytics)
yolo_training.close_mosaic: Disable mosaic for the last N epochs
yolo_training.export_onnx: Export ONNX after training (used by navigation and AI pre-label)
yolo_training.stratify: Stratify by class (every class reaches validation)
yolo_training.include_background: Add reviewed images without objects as negatives
yolo_training.preview_none: Click Preview split to see images and classes per split.
yolo_training.split_invalid: Train / val / test must sum to 100 with train and val above 0, and the negative share must be below 100.
yolo_training.preview_summary: {sources} segments, {images} images: {labeled} labeled, {background} negatives ({background_available} available), {unannotated} without annotation file (not used)
yolo_training.preview_unknown: Labels not in the class list (not trained): {labels}
yolo_training.no_segments: No segments: select segments on the calibration tab or use all project segments.
yolo_training.no_labeled: No labeled images to train on (train or val split is empty).
yolo_training.cannot_train: Training environment not available: detect it first; without Ultralytics run the Python prerequisites step (installs the CUDA or CPU PyTorch build and Ultralytics), or set an interpreter that has it.
yolo_training.busy: A training job is already running.
yolo_training.confirm_close_running: Training is still running; closing the window stops it. Continue?

advice.no_yolo_cli: No yolo command in the environment of {value}.
advice.torch_cpu_only_with_nvidia_gpu: NVIDIA GPU found but PyTorch is a CPU build ({value}): rerun the Python prerequisites step to install the CUDA build.
advice.device_cpu: No usable GPU; training on CPU ({value}) is slow.
advice.cache_ram: Enough memory to cache training images in RAM (about {value}).
advice.cache_off: Not enough memory to cache training images (about {value}); cache off.
advice.amp_off: No mixed precision for CPU / MPS training.
advice.epochs_for_dataset_size: Epochs from the number of labeled images: {value}
advice.small_dataset: Only {value} labeled images; use at least 50 (100+ objects per class works better).
advice.unknown_labels: These labels are not in the class list and are not trained: {value}
advice.no_validation: Validation split is empty; the model cannot be evaluated.
advice.imgsz_small_objects: Large source images: larger input size for small objects: {value}
